name: What kind of maintenance does attic insulation require?

mainEntity.name: What kind of maintenance does attic insulation require?

acceptedAnswer.text: Generally, attic insulation requires very little ongoing maintenance once properly installed. It's advisable to periodically inspect your attic every few years for any signs of damage, such as water leaks from the roof, pest infestations, or displaced insulation. If you notice any issues like compression, mold, or animal droppings, these should be addressed promptly to maintain the insulation's effectiveness and your home's energy efficiency. Regular checks can prevent minor issues from becoming costly repairs.
acceptedAnswer.description: Attic insulation typically requires minimal maintenance, mainly periodic checks every few years for damage like leaks, pests, or displacement.
